title: Engine diet: port RES4LYF's 3 nodes into MpiNodes
description: We use ClownsharKSampler_Beta + ClownModelLoader (Chroma, Krea2, character sheet) and Image Crop Location Exact (all character-sheet Flows). The pack is ~70k lines, pulls pywavelets/opencv/matplotlib, and broke a tester's engine by rewriting its own res4lyf.config.json (docs/comfy.md, MPI-1274). Port only the sampler/scheduler combos our workflows set. Part of the Engine diet umbrella.
